req.title: Update existing player
req.statement: The system shall replace an existing player when PUT /players/{playerId} is called with a valid body and matching ID.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should update an existing player when a valid PUT request is made. The test suite includes a positive test to verify successful updates, a negative test to handle mismatched squad numbers, and a boundary test to ensure correct handling of edge cases.

tests.name: test_update_existing_player_success
preconditions: A player with squad number 10 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to update the player with squad number 10.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a player with squad number 10
player_data = {
    "firstName": "John",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Forward"
}
client.post("/players/", json=player_data)

# Action: Update the player with squad number 10
update_data = {
    "firstName": "Jane",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Midfielder"
}
response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=update_data)

# Expected: The response status code is 204
assert response.status_code == 204

tests.name: test_update_player_mismatched_squad_number
preconditions: A player with squad number 10 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to update the player with a mismatched squad number in the body.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a player with squad number 10
player_data = {
    "firstName": "John",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Forward"
}
client.post("/players/", json=player_data)

# Action: Attempt to update the player with a mismatched squad number
update_data = {
    "firstName": "Jane",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "squadNumber": 11,
    "position": "Midfielder"
}
response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=update_data)

# Expected: The response status code is 400
assert response.status_code == 400
